title: Local affine flat counit presentation data
statement: Under the affine presentation hypothesis, for qcqs p:Y→B, relatively flat quasi-coherent M, g:A→B and a∈A, there exist affine opens S containing g(a), V containing a, and V≤g⁻¹(S), with a StandardSingleFlatCounitPresentation for p|S, M restricted to p⁻¹(S), and g.resLE S V. The bounded flat complex K lives on S and includes both identifications and the base-change equation. No global presentation on B is asserted.

proof.text: Choose affine neighborhoods S and V inside g⁻¹(S). Restrict p and M to p⁻¹(S); qcqs, quasi-coherence and relative flatness restrict. Apply the affine hypothesis on the top source open; transport across its isomorphism with the source, preserving the canonical mate equation. The result stays on S. Detailed proof in the Lean docstring.

theorem standardSingleFlatCounit_localization_presentation_data
    (h_affine : ∀ {Y₀ B₀ A₀ : Scheme.{u}} (p₀ : Y₀ ⟶ B₀)
      [QuasiCompact p₀] [QuasiSeparated p₀] [IsAffine B₀] [IsAffine A₀]
      (g₀ : A₀ ⟶ B₀), StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p₀ g₀ ⊤)
    {Y B A : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ B) [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p]
    (M : Y.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] (hM : M.IsFlatOver p) (g : A ⟶ B) (a : A) :
    letI := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦ HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    ∃ (S : B.Opens) (V : A.Opens), g a ∈ S ∧ a ∈ V ∧
      IsAffine S.toScheme ∧ IsAffine V.toScheme ∧
      ∃ hVS : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ S,
        StandardSingleFlatCounitPresentation (p ∣_ S)
          (M.restrict (p ⁻¹ᵁ S).ι) (g.resLE S V hVS)
